assumptions: Board is an axis-aligned square-pitch grid detected from saturated candy blobs in the central screen region.
Candy identity is its dominant hue; frosted/tiled cells keep the visible candy color.
Swipes between adjacent cell centers perform a swap.
Settled frames only: ambiguous/animated frames are rejected by unknown/colored-coverage thresholds.
limitations: Special candies (striped, wrapped, fish, color bomb) are treated as their base color and not used strategically.
Blockers, frosting layers and locked cells are not modeled; only plain match-3 scoring with a small bonus near non-candy cells.
Irregular/non-rectangular board shapes and partial columns may be rejected.
Objective counters (moves left, bear progress) are not read; the signature uses only board labels.
No cascade prediction; the chosen move is greedy on immediate match length.
